component.name: RustConn
component.summary: Manage SSH, RDP, and VNC connections

description.p: RustConn is a modern connection manager for Linux. Manage SSH, RDP, VNC, SPICE, MOSH, Telnet, Serial, Kubernetes, and Zero Trust connections from a single application with embedded protocol support and no external dependencies required.

Organize connections into groups and tags, split terminals side by side, automate tasks with expect scripts and command snippets, and synchronize configurations across devices via Cloud Sync. Import from Remmina, Asbru-CM, MobaXterm, Royal TS, SSH config, Ansible inventory, CSV, RDP files, or libvirt.

ul.li: SSH, MOSH, Telnet, Serial, and Kubernetes terminals with scrollbar and font zoom
Embedded RDP, VNC, and SPICE sessions with external client fallback
Zero Trust tunnels: AWS SSM, GCP IAP, Azure Bastion, Cloudflare, Teleport, Tailscale, and more
Cloud Sync via shared directories (Google Drive, Syncthing, Nextcloud, Dropbox)
Tab Overview, Tab Pinning, Split View, and cluster commands for managing many sessions
Credential storage via KeePassXC, GNOME Keyring, Bitwarden, 1Password, Passbolt, or Pass
SFTP file browser with split-panel navigation and remote host monitoring
Session recording, text highlighting, Wake-on-LAN, and custom terminal themes

description.p: Version 0.21.10 - macOS fixes across external viewers and browsers, and search and jump-host improvements:

ul.li: Fixed: "Open Browser via Tunnel" now finds a Chromium browser on macOS, where it is an .app bundle rather than a binary on PATH
Fixed: external RDP, VNC and SPICE viewers are detected as macOS .app bundles instead of being reported "not installed"
Fixed: the System-browser mode and the Cockpit template use the platform URL opener (open on macOS) instead of a hardcoded xdg-open
Fixed: a SPICE session on macOS uses the stored password again, falling back to the per-user temp directory when the runtime directory is absent
Fixed: connection search no longer matches entries with no visible relation to the query
Fixed: the Jump Host pickers in the Tunnel wizard, the connection wizard and a group's SSH settings now filter as you type
Added: the New/Edit Cluster dialog can filter its connection list

description.p: Version 0.21.9 - browse through an SSH host in one click, prompt for values at connect time, and connection-picker fixes:

ul.li: Open Browser via Tunnel — right-click an SSH connection to raise a SOCKS proxy and open a browser (embedded or external Chromium) routed through the host, with a configurable start page and external-browser command; it respects your default browser and falls back to the embedded browser with a toast when no Chromium browser is available
A Web connection can browse through an SSH host (SOCKS tunnel) in the embedded and a Chromium browser
Interactive "ASK" variables — prompt for a value at connect time
A dynamic SOCKS forward can pick a free local port automatically
Built-in date, time and environment variables in placeholder substitutions
Built-in Expect templates for the newer OpenSSH host-key prompt and bare "any key to continue" banners
Fixed: an embedded Web connection to an unreachable host no longer leaves a blank browser tab open
Fixed: the Jump Host and Tunnel dropdowns' search box now filters the list
Fixed: a ProxyCommand relay no longer leaves the target session hung at the password prompt (#322)
Fixed: the "Executing:" echo now quotes a ProxyCommand value so it no longer looks ignored (#322)

description.p: Version 0.21.8 - the embedded RDP clipboard file transfer works for the first time, with the security and robustness fixes that came with making it reachable:

ul.li: Copying files through the RDP clipboard now works in both directions. Downloading from the remote ("Save N Files") and dragging a file onto the session both transfer the file in full; a dropped file lands on the remote clipboard, and a toast reminds you to press Ctrl+V in the session to paste it
A password typed at an interactive prompt could be written to the session log in the clear; the input after a sensitive prompt is now redacted
An automation Expect-rule response can now use a connection-local variable, not only global and built-in ones

A filename sent by the server can no longer be written outside the folder you chose - an absolute path or ".." used to escape it. Names are reduced to one safe component and an existing file is never overwritten
A failed save no longer crashes the session, a refused file no longer leaves the batch reporting nothing, and a misbehaving server can no longer loop the download or corrupt a file
A server can no longer make the client reserve up to 4 GiB of memory for a single clipboard file request
Stored credentials could be printed in the clear by a debug dump; the secret settings and credential types now redact themselves
Bitwarden, 1Password and Passbolt calls can no longer hang the application forever on a slow or unreachable server
The automatic-login timeout can now be set on a group, not only a single connection
The window header on macOS is closer to a native titlebar height

description.p: Version 0.21.7 - a dialog that finally fits a small screen, accessibility fixes across the interface, and a round of dead-code removal:

ul.li: The Session Logs dialog can now be made narrow. Its file list collapses into an overlay on a small display and a header button toggles it, instead of being held wide by a fixed split

Client detection on the Clients page now says whether each client was found in words - Installed, Not found, or Using embedded client - so it no longer relies on colour and a symbol alone, and a screen reader can read it
The embedded VNC status screen and its Copy button now work in every language and give the same feedback the RDP session does
The Smart Folders right-click menus are now reachable from the keyboard and announced properly by a screen reader, matching the rest of the application
Fixed: adding an icon in the connection wizard and then pressing Advanced no longer loses it
Fixed: the connection editor now titles a Web address URL rather than Host, and drops the rows that a protocol does not use instead of leaving them empty

Fixed: several small visual and labelling issues - a doubled border around two lists, an information row with two icons, internal action names shown as shortcut descriptions, and switches that sat slightly apart from their neighbours
Every ellipsis in the interface is now a single character, which also merged some translations that had drifted apart
Removed a fullscreen button that never worked and a body of unreachable interface code

description.p: Version 0.21.6 - a confirmation before a snippet runs, a Bitwarden vault that unlocks in your own language, and failures that stop happening in silence:

ul.li: Snippets can now ask before they run. Turn on Confirm before running for a snippet whose accidental execution would be expensive, and RustConn shows the exact command and waits. It is off by default, and it covers every way a snippet can be started, including the entries in the terminal's right-click menu and the Scripts menu of a Windows session
The command-line tool honours the same flag, and refuses to run such a snippet unattended unless you pass --force

Fixed: Bitwarden never unlocked itself at startup in any interface language but English, even with the master password saved. The vault state was being compared as translated text, so outside English the check always concluded there was nothing to unlock

Fixed: the startup message said Bitwarden could not store passwords while it was storing them. The check was asking the Bitwarden tool a question without giving it the unlocked session, so it truthfully answered "locked"

Fixed: saving a password to Bitwarden could report a failure and save it anyway, then offer to store it somewhere else. Saving to a remote vault is slower than saving to this computer, and it was being given the same ten seconds; each kind of vault now gets a budget that suits it
Fixed: unlocking Bitwarden had no time limit at all, so an unlock that stalled on the network could wait forever with nothing on screen changing

Fixed: Add SSH Key appeared to do nothing when the file chooser could not open, and there was no way to find out why. It now says what went wrong, and clicking the button again reopens the chooser instead of leaving it stuck
Fixed: the Add Key passphrase dialog had no visible Cancel button, and Enter did not submit it
Fixed: changes to global variables that could not be written to disk were reported as saved, and were gone at the next start

Fixed: an SSH tunnel that failed to start, or that died on its own, could leave no trace at all — it looked exactly like a tunnel you had stopped on purpose. A failed tunnel now says so, carries the reason the SSH client gave, and updates while the tunnel window is open. When a tunnel needs a program that is missing, the message names the right package to install
Fixed: running a snippet from the terminal's right-click menu did nothing when one of its variables could not be filled in automatically. It now asks for the missing values

Fixed: with the system keyring, a password saved on a connection that is not in any group was never found again — connecting asked for it every time, and the connection editor's load and test buttons both reported it missing. Putting the connection into a group used to be the workaround; it is no longer needed

Fixed: every Windows session used a US English keyboard on machines whose console keymap is not configured, which is most desktops. The layout was being read from the wrong line, so a German or French keyboard typed the wrong characters with nothing pointing at the cause

Fixed: running RustConn with debug logging turned on wrote the RDP account password into the log in readable form, by way of a library that logs the whole authentication structure. Debug logs are what people attach to bug reports, so if you have run 0.21.5 or earlier with debug logging against a Windows host, treat that account's password as disclosed. The documentation now says what a debug log contains before it tells you how to make one

Fixed: asking to quit twice built a second confirmation dialog on top of the first, which made the first click look ignored when its window was behind another one or hidden to the tray. The pending question is now raised instead
Connecting is quicker when a password is not in your KeePassXC database: one of the three lookups RustConn made could never have matched, and each one reopens the database

Fixed: the Flathub build shipped without an H.264 decoder, so the built-in RDP client quietly fell back to an older image path on every Windows session that offered H.264. The decoder is now bundled with every Flatpak build of RustConn
The bundled RDP client is now FreeRDP 3.31.1, which stops the session window flickering on displays that are scaled, and maps several keys the client used to ignore

description.p: Version 0.21.5 - terminals that follow the desktop's appearance, a notification for a finished command, and packages that finally build what they can:

ul.li: Terminal colours can now follow the desktop's light or dark preference, through a new Follow System theme. Until now the System colour scheme reached only the window, so a light desktop could surround a dark terminal with no setting that paired them — and they now stay paired when the desktop switches while sessions are open

A new monitoring mode notifies you when a command finishes on the remote host, with its exit code, so "finished" and "failed with status 1" are different messages. The existing modes guess from output timing; this one reads an event the shell reports. It needs shell integration on the remote host
Every monitoring notification now leaves a mark on the tab until you look at it, visible in the tab bar and on the Tab Overview thumbnail
Fixed: the window rendered light on a dark desktop whenever the theme was set to System

Fixed: the Flatpak could not reach the new command notification at all, and the packages built for Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, openSUSE and macOS were quietly built against an older libadwaita than the one installed — in the Debian and Ubuntu case also without the in-tab browser. Every channel now asks what the system actually provides

Fixed: the .deb and .rpm attached to a GitHub release did not list every library the program loads, so the .deb installed and then refused to start with "error while loading shared libraries". Both now derive that list from the binary instead of carrying one written by hand

Fixed: the Debian and Ubuntu packages from the openSUSE Build Service never contained the in-tab web browser, because a build dependency was written in a form that let the build quietly proceed without it. Web connections in those packages could only open in an external browser

Fixed: openSUSE Slowroll had no package at all, because the build was offered a Rust compiled for a newer system library than Slowroll itself carries. It now uses the same self-contained toolchain the Fedora and Debian builds use

Fixed: every tray menu item that opens a session did nothing — Local Shell, Quick Connect and all of Recent Connections. The item highlighted on click and then nothing happened, on the KDE tray and on macOS alike

Fixed: five icons drew as broken placeholders, because the icon theme had dropped the names they asked for. One of them was the mark shown when a command finishes, on the very notification the new mode exists to deliver

Fixed: with the interface in any language other than English, KeePassXC was reported as unreadable when the database was open and healthy, and a password stored in the encrypted file became unreachable as a result
Fixed: local shell tabs were never monitored, in any mode, so the new command notification could not fire on one
Fixed: the monitoring bar's margins had never been applied, because they were spelled with property names GTK's CSS does not have

description.p: Version 0.21.4 - a SPICE-in-Flatpak fix, stricter CLI flags, and a documentation audit:

ul.li: A SPICE connection with a stored password no longer fails in Flatpak with "connection type cannot be detected from URI"; the password file is now handed to the host viewer at a path it can open, with a fallback to prompting
rustconn-cli now rejects --key and --auth-method for protocols that cannot use them instead of silently dropping them, and applies them to SFTP connections
--window-mode no longer claims to support SPICE, which always opens in an external viewer
The automatic-login timeout is now editable in the connection editor instead of only in the config file
The CLI reference and user guide were realigned with the code

description.p: Version 0.21.3 - making the secret backends honest about what they can and cannot do:

ul.li: A password the selected backend refused is no longer moved into the encrypted file behind your back; a refusal opens a dialog and offers the encrypted file as a deliberate choice
KeePassXC, pass and the KeePass resolve path no longer report an unreadable store as a missing entry, and no longer serve a password from somewhere else when the chosen store did not answer
The Secrets page and startup banner now name the backend in force and say whether it can actually store a password
"Enable fallback" is now "Also read from the encrypted file" and governs reads only
An embedded RDP session against a Windows 11 host is no longer killed by the server's own keepalive heartbeat
An idle window with no connections no longer shows network warnings during a Wi-Fi flap

description.p: Version 0.21.2 - four connection fixes, and a change to how SSH passwords are delivered:

ul.li: SSH through a jump host no longer hangs at the target password prompt when the proxy step is slow (#301)

Changed: a stored SSH password is now handed to OpenSSH through SSH_ASKPASS instead of typed into the terminal, in a mode-0600 runtime file whose path alone reaches the SSH environment. Connections that askpass does not cover keep the terminal watcher, so no authentication setup loses its stored password
SPICE now passes the configured password to remote-viewer instead of prompting every time (#308)
The embedded web browser keeps its login across restarts (#309)
A new Local Shell tab in Flatpak opens at the correct size when the window changed size since the last tab (#294)

description.p: Version 0.21.1 - a lookup that was repeated for nothing, and two things that were only broken in a package:

ul.li: Fixed: connections that authenticate with a key waited on a password manager lookup before every connect, then warned about the password they never wanted. Someone whose hosts are all key-authenticated, with no stored passwords at all, paid a full round trip each time; against the Bitwarden CLI that is several seconds, because it decrypts on every read, and the answer was the same every time. The empty answer is now remembered for five minutes, and the notice is only shown when the connection is actually set up to want a password. Which credential a connection uses is untouched: the cache sits after that decision, so a stale record can cost a lookup, never hand a connection the wrong password

Fixed: Local Shell failed to open on a host without script. The host shell is wrapped in script (util-linux) because that is what gives the shell job control, and it was called unconditionally; Fedora moved the binary into a package of its own in F42, so a minimal install does not have it. The host is now probed and the shell is run directly when script is missing, which loses job control and is still better than a button that does nothing

Fixed: quitting from the tray put the confirmation dialog on a window the user was not looking at. The tray route presented the window first only when it was hidden, but a window can be visible and still be behind others, on another workspace, or simply unfocused. It is now presented whenever there is something to confirm

Fixed: the embedded browser was missing from every .deb built on OBS, so Web connections there offered only System and Custom. The build never had the WebKitGTK development package it probes for. Flatpak, the RPMs and the .deb attached to the GitHub release were not affected

description.p: Version 0.21.0 - a bastion that was stored and then ignored, and things that waited for ever now give up:

ul.li: Fixed: a Jump Host set on a group or in Preferences was ignored when the connection actually opened. It was stored, shown in the editor as inherited and synced between machines, then dropped at connect time — for SSH when picked from the dropdown, and for RDP, VNC and SPICE however it was set. All seven places that start a connection now resolve it the same way, including the check that stops the target's password being offered to the bastion's own prompt

Fixed: the Secrets page in Settings could stay empty instead of listing the password managers it found. Each one is probed by running its command-line tool, the probes run together, and the page waited for the slowest — so one tool that never answered held all of them. Every probe now gives up after five seconds and reports that manager as unavailable

Fixed: a KeePass operation could freeze RustConn with no way out, because every call to keepassxc-cli waited indefinitely. A database on a network share that had gone away, or one locked by another program, left the window unresponsive. Reads now give up after ten seconds and writes after thirty, and the message names the likely cause — including a database whose key-derivation settings are too heavy for the machine
Fixed: printing from an RDP session could stall the session itself. The waits on the local print system are now bounded, so losing the answer costs the printer list rather than the connection

Fixed: a translated string could ship as English while every check reported the translations complete, because nothing verified that the translation template still matched the source. That had happened in three releases running, and is now checked
Fixed: a Flatpak build could be stopped by any one of seven download hosts having a bad day, and one did. The bundled sources now carry verified fallback mirrors

Security: nine advisory warnings are gone. The macOS tray was pulling in the whole GTK3 binding stack, unmaintained since 2024, and thirty-nine packages went with it. None of that code was ever run on any platform

description.p: Version 0.20.11 - two processes that outlived their welcome, and a viewer that was there all along:

ul.li: Fixed: closing RustConn, pressing Ctrl+Q or quitting from the tray with session tabs still open left every telnet, ssh and serial process running, so a device that allows only one connection at a time stayed occupied. Closing an individual tab always ended its process; quitting never closes the tabs, so that step was skipped
Fixed: quitting from the tray icon skipped the shutdown entirely — no close confirmation, and external viewers and detached session windows were left running too. It now behaves like Ctrl+Q

Fixed: a SPICE connection refused to open with "Install virt-viewer" on machines that had virt-viewer installed, and Settings then listed it as missing. Client detection relied on the external "which" program, which some systems no longer ship; it is now resolved without one, for every client RustConn looks for. Inside Flatpak, a viewer installed on the host is used

Security: the FreeRDP bundled in the Flatpak is updated from 3.30.0 to 3.31.0, which upstream describes as a security release with 22 advisories and asks distributors to install without delay. It is used by external RDP sessions and by every fallback from the embedded client

description.p: Version 0.20.10 - the release 0.20.9 could not become. No 0.20.9 package was ever built, so everything listed under it arrives here:

ul.li: Fixed: the command-line tool did not compile with the features every package enables, so all four 0.20.9 build jobs failed and no package, installer or store update was produced. The tag was left alone and this patch release replaces it

description.p: Version 0.20.9 - a jump host you set once, pinned connections in the sidebar, and Chinese:

ul.li: Added: a connection can now take its jump host from its group or from a new application-wide setting, instead of repeating the same bastion on every connection. Settings → Connection → Network holds the global one, and every connection has a Network Mode row on its Basic page to inherit it or go direct, whatever its protocol. The ProxyJump field says which jump host is in force when one is inherited

Added: the external RDP client can finally be told how to size its window — fit to screen, fullscreen, a custom resolution or all monitors — from a new External Window row in the connection editor's Display group. Display Scale and Color Depth are now sent to it as well, having been collected and never used

Fixed: an external RDP window opened at roughly a quarter of a 4K screen, because the size it was given came from the embedded viewer's own widget geometry in logical pixels. Every RDP connection also stored a 1920x1080 resolution nobody chose, which that mode then applied; a connection that deliberately used a fixed size needs Custom resolution selected once

Fixed: a jump host set on a group was stored and shown but never actually used to reach its connections. A group configured with only a jump host also lost it on the next save, and the bastion fields were hidden until an authentication method was picked
Fixed: whether a connection inherited its group's bastion depended on an unrelated setting — where it got its SSH key — and remote desktop connections inherited it with no way to refuse

Fixed: a pinned connection's entry in its own group never showed anything — no connected indicator, no recording dot, no external-viewer marker — and right-clicking it offered Connect for a session that was already open
Fixed: the recording dot, the external-viewer marker and the split-view marker disappeared from the sidebar after a rename, a duplicate, a pin, a re-sort or a drag-and-drop
Fixed: the Simplified Chinese translation has never loaded, in any package, since it was contributed — the catalogue was installed under a directory name the system never looks in
Changed: the sidebar's "Open new session" is now offered for any connection that has a session, embedded or external, rather than only for external viewers
Changed: a Windows host that requires Remote Desktop licensing is now named as such rather than reported as incompatible. Such sessions still open through the external FreeRDP client
Changed: when an installed H.264 library is refused, the reason is now given — the decoder only accepts the builds Cisco publishes itself — and RUSTCONN_OPENH264 can point at one
Improved: a locked keyring can no longer stall a credential lookup indefinitely; every request now has its own deadline and says which one timed out

description.p: Version 0.20.8 - context menu placement, Web connection settings and readability:

ul.li: Fixed: the sidebar right-click menu did not open at all when the window sat low enough that the menu had no room below the pointer. Moving the window up made the same click work. The menu now scrolls instead of demanding its full height

Fixed: Web bookmarks set to open in the embedded browser reverted to the system browser, and the choice was then lost for good. A build without the embedded browser used to overwrite that setting silently on the next save of any connection
Fixed: editing a Web bookmark reset its saved page zoom and its certificate exception, and could pick up the custom browser command or user agent of whichever connection was edited before it
Fixed: the toolbar over an embedded RDP or VNC session was barely readable on a light theme — Copy, Paste and Autotype were dark text on a dark bar. Embedded toolbars now follow the desktop theme
Fixed: saving settings could briefly freeze the window, and a message about "another rustconn instance" appeared after every connection even with no second instance running
Fixed: looking up a password opened 25 separate encrypted keyring sessions instead of one, adding a third of a second to every connection whose password was not found

description.p: Version 0.20.7 - reconnect, cloned connections and the sidebar context menu:

ul.li: Fixed: an SSH session that ended or dropped offered no way to reconnect — the "Session disconnected" banner, the sidebar offline indicator and automatic reconnection were all suppressed whenever session logging was enabled, because both used the same notification slot and logging claimed it last

Fixed: cloned connections could not be edited and their right-click menu did not open — a rebuilt sidebar row cleared the selection that Edit, Rename, Duplicate and Delete all act on, and an unresolved right-click blocked the fallback that would have opened the menu

Fixed: the sidebar context menu opened and disappeared again within a frame on GNOME Wayland — the menu was attached to a row widget the list reuses, and it held no input grab, which a Wayland compositor cancels. It is now attached to the connection list itself and takes the grab
Changed: on Wayland, moving the context menu from one row to another takes a second right-click, a consequence of the grab above. X11 is unchanged

description.p: Version 0.20.6 - H.264 for RDP on more systems, and clearer credential feedback:

ul.li: Fixed: RDP used the RemoteFX path even with OpenH264 installed — the H.264 probe looked only for the unversioned library name, which ships in the development package, so a normal install was reported as missing. Versioned library names are now found, which restores the more efficient H.264 pipeline

Fixed: the passphrase for the portable credential file could be discarded without saying why — the confirmation requirement is now always visible, is re-checked when the file path changes, and is reported after the Preferences window closes
Fixed: spurious warnings logged when quitting with sessions open, and about a portable passphrase that was never entered
Fixed: macOS Dock icon changed to a generic tile when the application was pinned and closed
Improved: sidebar connection status is updated once per change instead of twice
Improved: the header bar Shell button no longer competes visually with the welcome screen's primary action
Improved: macOS font scaling, icon-only Settings tabs, and more compact welcome rows

description.p: Version 0.20.5 - Flatpak terminal size fix and shortcut conflict warnings:

ul.li: Fixed: Flatpak terminal still started at 24x80 on some hosts — the host shell now starts once the terminal widget has been allocated, so the host-side PTY inherits the real size (issue #294)
Fixed: shortcut recorder did not warn about conflicts with fixed shortcuts like Ctrl+V for Paste connection (issue #295)
Documentation: WSL guide updated with Flatpak install option and single-line Ubuntu command

description.p: Version 0.20.4 - cloud-syncable credential storage:

ul.li: Added: portable encrypted file backend — one passphrase-protected credential file that syncs between your machines via cloud storage, including across Linux and macOS (issue #293)
Added: copy stored passwords from any password store into any other, with progress and a Stop button
Added: change the portable file's passphrase, re-encrypting every password in it under the new one
Added: the passphrase field warns when the passphrase would be quick to guess
Fixed: terminal starts at the real window size instead of 24x80 (issue #294)
Fixed: keyboard shortcuts window shows remapped bindings instead of defaults, and lists the shortcuts that cannot be rebound (issue #295)
Improved: rustconn-cli --backend accepts encrypted-file and portable
Localisation: new strings translated in all 17 locales; Georgian (ka) added (PR #296, Ekaterine Papava)

description.p: Version 0.20.3 - keyboard passthrough persistence and sidebar tooltip paths:

ul.li: Keyboard passthrough state saved across restarts
Sidebar tooltips show full tree path for deeply nested items

description.p: Version 0.20.2 - polish release merging community pull requests:

ul.li: Added: Settings, Interface — reveal session toolbar on hover or click only (PR #286)
Fixed: duplicating a connection with vault credentials left the duplicate without a stored secret (PR #280)
Fixed: a reconnected terminal stacked child-exited handlers, running the disconnect path multiple times (PR #283)

description.p: Version 0.20.1 - connection name labels in split panes, and a round of session-lifecycle fixes:

ul.li: Added: Settings, Interface, Window — Show connection name in split panes, a compact colored header with the connection name and protocol, off by default (#277)
Fixed: group names are now unique per parent folder rather than globally, so "Site A/RDP" and "Site B/RDP" can both exist and CSV imports no longer merge unrelated branches (#291)

Fixed: a split pane could not be closed at all when its connection had the floating toolbar switched off — the panel's own detach and close buttons were suppressed along with the session toolbar (#260)
Fixed: RDP — xrdp hosts no longer stop at their own greeter after a successful NLA exchange (#290)
Fixed: opening the connection dialog crashed the application when an SSH agent key had a non-ASCII comment (#278)
Fixed: vault credentials were not found for connections inside a group, so every one of them prompted for a password (#289)
Fixed: minimizing to tray silently destroyed port forwards, recordings and external viewers (#279)
Fixed: a post-disconnect automation task froze the entire application for up to 60 seconds (#281)
Fixed: remote session recordings were lost when quitting the application (#282)
Fixed: Web embedded — links requesting a new view (target _blank, window.open) did nothing (#288)
Fixed: the network monitor reported a false outage on every Flatpak launch, and its debounce erased short flaps so the recovery sweep never ran (#284)
Fixed: a session closed with "exit" was silently reconnected on the next Wi-Fi roam (#285)

Fixed: Web embedded — the toolbar's reveal handle was unreachable in a split pane, buried under the split view's own panel arrow at the same corner; the handle is back at the top centre for every viewer
Fixed: three strings new in this release reached only Ukrainian, one of them never extracted into the translation template at all; all 16 catalogues are complete again

description.p: Version 0.20.0 - Web embedded mode floating toolbar, renderer choice, signed release artifacts:

ul.li: Added: opening a cluster labels every member tab with a tab group named after the cluster, so Close All in Group closes the whole cluster
Added: signed build provenance for every deb, rpm, AppImage and Flatpak bundle attached to a GitHub release — verify a download with "gh attestation verify"
Added: Web embedded mode with auto-hide floating toolbar matching RDP/VNC behavior
Added: Settings, Interface, Rendering — Automatic, Hardware (GPU) or Software (Cairo), applied at the next start (#274)
Fixed: an RDP, VNC, SPICE or Web member of a cluster was never registered in it, so "Disconnect all cluster sessions" could not close it
Fixed: a tab returning from a split pane lost its group label
Fixed: the floating viewer toolbar was revealed but not clickable for its first two seconds in RDP, VNC and Web sessions
Fixed: choosing a non-system interface language cost macOS users the tray icon — the language re-exec is gone (#158)
Fixed: Web zoom shortcuts (Ctrl+/-/0) did not work in split view
Fixed: Web toolbar clipped instead of collapsing in a narrow split panel; the collapse point is now measured rather than a fixed pixel breakpoint
Fixed: the Web reveal handle sat over the page's top centre, and the floating toolbar ignored the local theme
Fixed: a failed Web page load left the toolbar logic unrun, and the load timeout reported nothing
Fixed: the header bar's busy spinner lost its accessible name
Fixed: macOS inside a virtual machine had input lag and stuttering scroll — the automatic renderer choice now detects a hypervisor and selects Cairo (#274)
Fixed: seven translatable strings were in the source but in no catalogue; now translated in all 16 locales
Changed: the Web load timeout now reports itself in the reconnect banner
Improved: neither the X11 Cairo fallback nor the language selection re-execs the process any more — both environment writes moved into the new rustconn-env-sys crate
Improved: terminal/mod.rs split into three modules — 4365 lines down to 3052
Improved: adw::Spinner where the runtime has it, gtk4::Spinner where it does not, decided in one module
Improved: the three FFI crates now inherit the workspace clippy lint set
Documentation: how to verify a downloaded release artifact

description.p: Version 0.19.22 - KeePassXC unlock on demand, search caching, keyboard label clarity:

ul.li: Fixed: KeePassXC "Don't save" mode did not unlock the database on demand, reporting credentials as missing (#273)
Improved: Sidebar search uses a cached search engine with result caching for better responsiveness on large databases

Improved: Keyboard group dropdowns show what "Automatic" actually sends — Automatic (^?) for Backspace, Automatic (\e[3~) for Delete — so users know which option to select when the default fails (#271)

description.p: Version 0.19.21 - startup fix for the setlocale guard:

ul.li: Fixed: RustConn did not start at all on Fedora 44 — the setlocale guard required exactly one live thread, a state an application cannot arrange, and aborted the process before the window appeared (#271)

Fixed: the guard now samples the thread count on its first call and refuses only when the count grows past that baseline, so a thread spawned by a shared library before main() no longer blocks startup (#271)
Changed: the thread-count clause of the setlocale contract is documented as a judgement rather than a proof (#267)

description.p: Version 0.19.20 - SSH/MOSH keyboard control, import robustness, keyring reliability:

ul.li: Added: SSH/MOSH connections can choose what Backspace and Delete send (#271)
Fixed: Saving Preferences threw away the Backspace/Delete choice on a live session (#271)
Fixed: SFTP connections offered a Keyboard group that did nothing (#271)
Fixed: RDM JSON import still aborted on an integer field, one bad entry cost the whole file (#234)
Fixed: Royal TS Telnet sessions were imported as SSH on port 22 (#234)
Fixed: Royal TS import gave no hint why connections came in without a password (#234)
Fixed: Import warnings were permanently English (#234)
Fixed: An import that produced nothing claimed success (#234)
Fixed: KeePass database password was never written to the system keyring (#272)
Fixed: Re-entering a vault password in Settings was discarded as no change (#272)
Fixed: Bitwarden, 1Password and Passbolt had the same keyring hole as KeePass (#272)
Fixed: 1Password and Passbolt wrote a placeholder literal to disk (#272)
Fixed: Moving a secret from encrypted file to system keyring destroyed it (#272)
Fixed: Turning a backend off left the old keyring entry behind (#272)
Fixed: A failed keyring write was a log line under a Settings saved toast (#272)
Changed: RUSTSEC-2026-0244 resolved via new rustconn-locale-sys crate (#267)

description.p: Version 0.19.19 - vault credential lifecycle fixes:

ul.li: Fixed: Deleting a connection now removes its credential from the password vault (#263)
Fixed: Renaming a connection in the configuration panel now updates the vault entry (#263)
Fixed: Credentials of connections outside any group were missed by vault cleanup and migration
Fixed: System Keyring entries are now visible in KDE Wallet, the item label uses / instead of : (#264)
Fixed: Moving a connection between groups no longer orphans its keyring entry (#264)
Fixed: Deleting a group with a vault password no longer leaves a mangled orphan entry in KeePass
Fixed: macOS Keychain credentials were stored where the resolver never looked
Improved: Keyring credential retrieval wipes its intermediate plaintext buffers
Changed: Saved interface language is applied only during startup, before any thread exists

description.p: Version 0.19.18 - Secret backend credential management fixes:

ul.li: Fixed: Renaming a connection now updates the credential entry in the password vault (#263)
Fixed: System Keyring password collision for same-named connections in different groups (#264)
Fixed: KeePass database password keyring entry now namespaced with RustConn prefix (#265)
System Keyring credentials transparently migrated to new hierarchical key format on first access

description.p: Version 0.19.17 - Settings stability and dialog improvements:

ul.li: Fixed Settings panel wiping in-memory KeePassXC database password on close (#259)
Fixed OCI CLI version detection showing Python tracebacks
Improved Settings dialog with dirty-tracking, async vault operations and background keyring saves
Improved Import dialog with background file parsing and clear error messaging
Improved Export dialog with non-blocking file manager open

description.p: Version 0.19.16 - clipboard crash mitigation (issue #261):

ul.li: Fixed embedded RDP reading the local clipboard on every desktop copy instead of only on paste
Fixed Clipboard Off setting not gating toolbar Copy, Paste and Type Clipboard buttons

description.p: Version 0.19.15 - embedded RDP graphics pipeline fixes, VTE crash fix, clipboard leak fix:

ul.li: Fixed embedded RDP sessions in Automatic graphics mode showing a frozen desktop (#262)
Fixed scrolling, window drags and solid fills silently discarded in GFX sessions (#262)
Fixed sessions with no OpenH264 opening a GFX channel they could not paint through (#262)
Fixed session status bar reporting a graphics pipeline the session was not using (#262)
Fixed pressing Backspace in a session killing the whole window (VTE assertion failure)
Fixed embedded RDP clipboard watcher leak causing coredumps (#261)
Improved embedded RDP rendering performance
Improved split view panel buttons auto-hide behind an arrow indicator
Added: Local Shell button in an empty split panel
Fixed: Closing one pane took the whole split layout apart
Fixed: Session logs lost output and repeated screens; they are now written from the session's own PTY (#247)
Fixed: Opening Settings corrupted KeePassXC config (#259)
Improved: One PTY path for every session on every platform (#175)

description.p: Version 0.19.13 - RDM import tolerance, auto-hide floating toolbar for RDP and VNC:

ul.li: Added US Dvorak RDP keyboard layout
Fixed RDM JSON import rejecting real-world Devolutions exports containing numeric fields
Improved session transcript to capture initial connection output within 500 ms
Improved embedded RDP and VNC toolbar to float as an auto-hide overlay, no longer consuming vertical space or affecting resolution

description.p: Version 0.19.12 - terminal history survives a reconnect, automatic login for Telnet and serial, SFTP through a jump host:

ul.li: Added preservation of terminal history across a reconnect
Added automatic login for Telnet and serial sessions, with configurable prompt text
Added Remove from Split and Remove Split, so a session can leave a split view without being closed
Fixed SFTP being unable to reach a host behind a jump host
Fixed a jump host picked from the connection list being ignored by every SFTP path
Fixed ${password} in an automation expect rule resolving to nothing, so the sudo template answered the prompt with an empty line
Fixed connect and prompt detection reading the oldest scrollback instead of the visible screen
Fixed an expect-rule response being written to the application log in clear text
Fixed Move to New Tab and Close Connection in a split pane's context menu doing nothing
Fixed broadcast mirroring keystrokes out of a session that had left the split
Improved the file-manager SFTP path, which now warns instead of failing silently

description.p: Version 0.19.11 - vault and packaging fixes, lighter background sessions:

ul.li: Fixed KeePassXC group passwords failing to load from a password-protected database
Fixed the Homebrew formula staying pinned to an old version after every automated release
Fixed the snap keyring error not naming the snap connect command needed to fix it
Improved embedded RDP CPU usage for sessions in a background tab
Improved allocation behaviour when listing connections and groups
Improved responsiveness of emptying the trash

description.p: Version 0.19.10 - session logging that works, and reconnect after sleep:

ul.li: Added Session Logs to the primary menu and Session Log to a connection's context menu
Fixed session logging configured on a connection never writing anything
Fixed session logs recording typed passwords in clear text
Fixed Retention (days) never deleting a file
Fixed the Timestamps switch doing nothing
Fixed a log file that could not be created failing silently
Fixed the KDBX use password and use key file switches only hiding rows
Fixed eight RDP and VNC dropdown labels being untranslated in every language
Fixed RDP and VNC sessions freezing instead of reconnecting after the computer woke from sleep
Added resume detection so a frozen session is dimmed and offered its reconnect banner at once
Fixed picking a key from the SSH agent not restricting which key was offered
Removed the Encrypted Documents feature, which was never reachable

description.p: Version 0.19.9 - RDP audio routing, snap startup and RD Gateway fixes:

ul.li: Added a three-state RDP audio setting: play on this computer, on the remote computer, or not at all
Fixed the RDP audio setting being ignored at connect time, which left every session with audio disabled
Fixed custom FreeRDP arguments being dropped silently in embedded mode
Pinned the PulseAudio and ALSA backends in the bundled FreeRDP so it cannot ship without sound
Fixed the snap package failing to start because WebKitGTK libraries were missing
Fixed RDP through an RD Gateway resolving the target host locally and failing
Fixed the RD Gateway tunnel sending an empty user name and a portless endpoint
Fixed a failed gateway tunnel stranding the session instead of falling back to FreeRDP
Fixed .rdp import reading the gateway port from a non-standard field

description.p: Version 0.19.8 - importing from Remote Desktop Manager and Royal TS:

ul.li: Fixed Remote Desktop Manager JSON import aborting on the first entry
Fixed RDM import losing usernames, passwords and the folder hierarchy
Fixed Royal TS import skipping every RDP connection
Fixed Royal TS connections importing without a username
Added support for compressed .rtsz and uncompressed .rtsx Royal TS documents
Fixed XML entities corrupting imported Royal TS names
Unsupported entries are now reported as skipped with their source type
Added a setting to open a new session on every double-click

description.p: Version 0.19.7 - opening connections, session restore and Custom Command credentials:

ul.li: Fixed double-clicking a connection focusing a disconnected tab instead of connecting
Fixed Enter in the connection sidebar not opening the selected connection
Implemented Restore sessions on startup, which previously had no effect
Fixed an unresolvable hostname aborting the connection instead of just skipping the probe
Added resolution of mDNS .local hostnames inside the Flatpak sandbox
Added the password placeholder to Custom Command templates, passed through the environment
Fixed Host, Port, Username and password not being editable for a Custom Command

description.p: Version 0.19.6 - macOS reliability, self-contained distribution and local release auditing:

ul.li: Fixed auxiliary secrets on macOS to use the native Keychain instead of a Linux-only command
Added a local-only macOS CI and release audit workflow
Improved the application and DMG to bundle and relocate all 58 non-system dynamic libraries
Added explicit ad-hoc and Developer ID hardened-runtime signing
Added optional notarization, stapling and validation for release artifacts
Synchronized one canonical macOS feature profile across all build and packaging paths

description.p: Version 0.19.5 - Custom Command variables, nested folders and long-hostname SSH fix:

ul.li: Fixed SSH sessions dying on long hostnames because the ControlMaster socket path overflowed
Fixed variable placeholders never being substituted in a Custom Command template
Fixed a Custom Command leaving a dead terminal tab behind after a one-shot launcher exits
Fixed the Tags field being hidden for Custom Command connections
Fixed folders not being nestable by drag and drop in the sidebar
Fixed multi-codepoint emoji icons being saved but never drawn
Improved icon rendering: an icon name missing from the theme falls back to a visible default

description.p: Version 0.19.4 - Detachable session windows and RDP fallback fixes:

ul.li: Added detachable session windows: move a session to its own window and back
Added Ctrl+Shift+M to toggle a session between a tab and its own window
Added per-monitor fullscreen option for detached sessions
Fixed RDP connection failing when the server only supports Standard RDP Security
Fixed FreeRDP fallback broken on FreeRDP 3.24 and 3.25
Fixed CredSSP logon failures triggering a pointless FreeRDP fallback
Improved RDP failure classification with unit-tested rules

description.p: Version 0.19.3 - FreeRDP compatibility and startup improvements:

ul.li: Added option to hide Welcome tab at startup
Fixed FreeRDP fallback failing on FreeRDP 3.26+ due to args-from exclusivity
Fixed RDP clipboard syncing even when disabled in connection settings
Fixed SSH MPTCP using non-existent TCPMultipath option

description.p: Version 0.19.2 - MPTCP support and SSH tunnel stability:

ul.li: Added Multipath TCP (MPTCP) support for SSH, RDP, and VNC connections
Fixed VPN connect/disconnect no longer kills healthy SSH sessions

description.p: Version 0.19.1 - RDP and SSH connection fixes:

ul.li: Fixed RDP certificate mismatch causing silent connection failure
Fixed SSH password auto-fill intermittently stuck on prompt

description.p: Version 0.19.0 - Embedded web browser for Web connections:

ul.li: Embedded WebKitGTK 6.0 web browser for Web connections (Linux)
Browser mode selection: Embedded, System, or Custom browser command
Per-connection persistent sessions with isolated cookies and local storage
Navigation toolbar with back/forward/reload/home and zoom controls
Credential autofill via JavaScript injection and HTTP Basic Auth
JavaScript enable/disable toggle per connection
Split view support for embedded web alongside terminals
web-embedded feature flag (default on Linux, excluded on macOS)

description.p: Version 0.18.12 - Graphics Pipeline control and VNC cursor fix:

ul.li: Added Graphics Pipeline selector (Auto/Legacy/RemoteFX) for embedded RDP connections (issue #218)
Fixed missing mouse cursor on remote Wayland VNC sessions (issue #220)

description.p: Version 0.18.11 - VNC cursor and RDP fallback improvements:

ul.li: Fixed missing mouse cursor on remote Wayland sessions over VNC (#220)
Embedded RDP now retries without GFX pipeline before falling back to FreeRDP (#218)
Nix flake: tests no longer run during nix build

description.p: Version 0.18.10 - Nix flake and RDP watchdog fix:

ul.li: Added Nix flake for NixOS / Nix users (nix run, nix profile install)
Fixed embedded RDP false Server Incompatible fallback on Windows Server 2019 with AD auth (#218)
Fixed FreeRDP fallback Authentication failed on single-session servers

description.p: Version 0.18.9 - Security and stability improvements:

ul.li: Vault password retrieval now properly zeroizes intermediates (9 backends)
Clipboard password wrapped in Zeroizing for auto-clear
Pre/post-connect tasks enforce 60s timeout ceiling to prevent UI freeze
Keyring save operations have 5-second timeout
FreeRDP updated to 3.29.0 (22 security advisories resolved)
Cleaned up cargo-deny configuration

description.p: Version 0.18.8 - Network resilience and keyboard improvements:

ul.li: Fixed: Connections stop working when switching network interfaces (#217)
Fixed: SSH connections hang for minutes after VPN/network change
Fixed: Terminal keyboard shortcuts work after remapping (#216)
Improved: Network monitor skips reconnect behind captive portals
Improved: Rate-limits reactions during VPN reconnect loops
Improved: Embedded RDP/VNC sessions reconnect on network change

description.p: Version 0.18.7 - Headless core/CLI cleanup:

ul.li: rustconn-core defaults to an empty feature set for headless domain use
CLI is minimal by default; connect and secret commands are opt-in features
System keyring integration gated behind explicit feature flag
NO_COLOR environment variable handling follows the specification
Updated dependencies: rustls, uuid, rand, mio, and others

description.p: Version 0.18.5 - GFX pipeline with H.264, embedded RDP improvements:

ul.li: EGFX graphics pipeline with H.264/AVC decoding via OpenH264 for dramatically better image quality over WAN
Native Display Scale mode now uses the real fractional compositor scale for pixel-perfect rendering on 125%/150% displays
Eliminated 3–4 redundant screen repaints on initial RDP connection (toolbar layout race)
Adaptive session polling reduces idle CPU usage by 3× on static desktops
Clipboard file transfers no longer stall the RDP event loop (async I/O)
Password intermediate is now zeroized immediately after handoff to IronRDP
Improved Cairo downscale filter quality (Filter::Good) when Display Scale exceeds 1×
Many bug fixes for terminal search, settings persistence, snippet editor, and more

description.p: Version 0.18.4 - SFTP home directory, viewer cleanup, and dependency unblock:

ul.li: The SFTP file browser now opens in your login home directory instead of the server root (#212)
A new optional SFTP Remote Directory field lets you pin an explicit path for chroot or non-standard layouts
External viewers are no longer left as zombie processes when the app shuts down without exiting
The sidebar bottom toolbar now matches the header bar's icon size and spacing
SFTP home-directory detection caches failed probes, honours a per-connection SSH agent socket, and adds keepalives
libadwaita updated to 0.9.2 (pin lifted), plus der, inotify, regex, zerocopy, and zlib-rs patch bumps

description.p: Version 0.18.3 - external-session tracking and sidebar indicators:

ul.li: VNC, RDP, and SPICE connections opened in External Window mode no longer leave a dead, unusable tab (#209)
External-viewer sessions are now tracked and surfaced in the sidebar with a window emblem next to the connected status
A right-click context menu adds Disconnect and Stop tracking for external-viewer sessions
Double-clicking a connection with an active session now focuses it instead of opening a duplicate
Orthogonal sidebar state indicators use shape plus icon, staying distinguishable in grayscale
Optional "Show connection in window title" switch lets time-tracking tools attribute usage per connection (#211)
Disconnecting an external viewer no longer briefly freezes the interface
Fixed Telnet connections stuck on the Vault password source (#210)

description.p: Version 0.18.2 - SPICE unix sockets and a compact-interface overhaul:

ul.li: Connect to SPICE servers over a local unix socket (spice+unix://), with a Browse button in the SPICE tab
Compact interface is now reachable from the primary menu and a Ctrl+Shift+D shortcut
New automatic compact mode that engages on small windows and relaxes when the window grows
Compact mode now covers the monitoring bar, split panels, and playback toolbar, with larger minimum tap targets
Fixed the SPICE CA-certificate Browse button, which previously did nothing
Fixed compact mode inflating the header and banner area instead of shrinking it
Bundled FreeRDP updated to 3.28.0 in the Flatpak build

description.p: Version 0.18.1 - embedded split view, workspace restore, and RDP fixes:

ul.li: Split view now works for embedded RDP, VNC, and SPICE tabs, mixable with terminals
Embedded viewers adapt their toolbar and resolution to narrow panels and small windows
Fixed embedded RDP small-window scaling, a blank viewer after unsplit, and a resize loop
Fixed SSH ProxyCommand parallel connections failing with "Permission denied (publickey)"
Fixed workspace restore for RDP/VNC/SPICE, Local Shell, and multi-panel split layouts

description.p: Version 0.18.0 — HiDPI remote desktops and a large internal cleanup:

ul.li: Added a Native (full HiDPI) Display Scale option for embedded RDP/VNC — a retina mode that follows the live display scale, alongside Auto and 125–400%
Fixed embedded VNC showing noise on Tight/JPEG rectangles — the client now decodes JPEG and re-enables the Tight encoding
Fixed embedded VNC leaving stale regions after a server-side scroll or window move
Fixed the RDP display scale being lost on dynamic resize, and the HiDPI cursor rendering half-missing and mis-sized
Fixed several interface strings never being translated because of an escape-encoding bug; typographic text now localises correctly
Changed operation-result feedback to non-blocking toasts, and a secret-save failure to a blocking dialog to prevent silent credential loss
Improved performance — fewer allocations in search results and removed redundant per-frame video buffer copies
Removed the abandoned native embedded SPICE experiment, an unused KeePassXC browser-integration backend, and other dead code (SPICE still works via the external viewer)
Updated desktop-integration dependencies (cpal, muda, tray-icon)

description.p: Version 0.17.10 — audit-driven protocol, performance and cleanup fixes:

ul.li: Fixed embedded RDP/VNC requesting a scale-inflated resolution on HiDPI displays — the remote desktop is requested at the widget's logical size instead of device pixels, cutting HiDPI bandwidth and restoring comfortable remote UI sizing
Fixed embedded SPICE showing a black, unresponsive screen by default — the embedded SPICE path is no longer enabled by default; SPICE now uses the working external viewer
Fixed embedded VNC rendering garbage against TightVNC/TigerVNC — the Tight encoding is removed from the defaults; ZRLE, CopyRect and Raw remain
Fixed VNC input momentarily stalling the interface — commands are now sent non-blocking on the main thread
Improved embedded RDP frame handling — removed a redundant per-frame buffer copy on the IronRDP path
Improved sidebar search performance — result lookup is now constant-time
Removed a dead multi-monitor detection placeholder and an unused dependency

description.p: Version 0.17.9 — SSH multi-hop and embedded RDP fixes:

ul.li: Fixed SSH multi-hop password chains still crashing when a bastion's host key is unknown — first-seen host keys are now accepted non-interactively (accept-new) so the host-key prompt is never routed to the password helper; a changed key is still rejected, preserving MITM protection (issue #203)

Fixed the embedded RDP first frame being blurry and never sharpening — the desktop is re-requested at the drawing area's real size once layout settles, so the first real frame arrives at a 1:1 pixel map (pull #206)

Fixed the embedded RDP initial snap causing a visible connect to reconnect flicker and occasional connection resets — the snap now runs only once the Display Control channel is confirmed ready and is never forced on a timer, so a slow server no longer triggers a reconnect (pull #206)

Fixed a stale seam/line left on the embedded RDP screen after a resolution change — the client now requests a full-screen repaint on every resize instead of leaving an untouched strip with its old fill (pull #206)

Fixed over-conservative embedded RDP resolution rounding — dimensions are rounded to the minimum the protocol requires and clamped to 7680x4320, so a resize on a larger-than-4K display is no longer silently rejected

description.p: Version 0.17.8 — locale-independent minimum window width and Asbru import fix:

ul.li: Fixed nested groups losing their parent when importing an Asbru-CM config with three or more group levels — the import now sorts groups deterministically so arbitrarily deep hierarchies are preserved on every import (issue #205)

Fixed a too-large minimum window width in some locales (notably German) that prevented tiling or resizing the window narrow — the runtime width measurement now collapses the sidebar first, as the narrow layout tier does, so localized sidebar labels no longer inflate the minimum (issue #204)
Fixed the welcome-screen hint holding the window wider in verbose locales — the hint now wraps instead of reporting its full translated width (issue #204)

description.p: Version 0.17.7 — adaptive narrow-window layout, SSH multi-hop password fix, Snap build fix:

ul.li: Window controls no longer vanish on narrow widths; the window now shrinks smoothly to a measured minimum, sheds non-essential header buttons and auto-hides the sidebar as it narrows, and the welcome screen reflows its columns instead of wrapping shortcut labels character-by-character (issue #204)
SSH multi-hop password chain: entry bastions in nested ProxyCommand now receive their own per-hop SSH_ASKPASS helper, fixing double-bastion password chains that crashed instantly (issue #203)
Snap build fixed for Snapcraft 9.0 on Launchpad — switched to plugin: nil with explicit rustup install, bypassing the broken environment validation
Security: updated quick-xml to 0.41.0, closing two advisories (RUSTSEC-2026-0194/0195) where crafted XML could exhaust memory on the RoyalTS/libvirt import paths

description.p: Version 0.17.6 — RDP resize fix, resilient secret storage, and window state:

ul.li: RDP sessions no longer abort on resize — bulk compression is no longer requested, so servers never send compressed FastPath updates that desynchronised across a resize (issue #200)
Saving Preferences no longer wipes persisted window and sidebar state — window size/maximized, expanded groups, and search history are preserved (issue #202)
Credentials are no longer silently lost when the system keyring is unavailable — an actionable dialog appears and RustConn falls back to the encrypted-file store (issue #201)
The window now remembers its maximized state across restarts (issue #202)
New application-managed encrypted-file secret backend (AES-256-GCM) for hosts without a system keyring
Proactive keyring availability warnings at startup and in Settings, Secrets
The Linux/BSD keyring path moved to the in-process oo7 client, dropping bundled libsecret/secret-tool from Flatpak

description.p: Version 0.17.5 — RDP resize/fallback fixes, SSH auto-login, and arm64 snap:

ul.li: Embedded RDP sessions no longer abort when resized — the decompressor is rebuilt for the negotiated compression type after a Deactivation-Reactivation Sequence (issue #200)
RDP to GNOME Remote Desktop now transparently falls back to the external FreeRDP client instead of dead-ending (issue #199)
Fixed the native arm64 snap link step by resolving both halves of pango from the SDK (issue #198)
Variable password auto-login now works on network equipment via cursor-position prompt detection (issue #194)
Jump host authenticates with its own Variable/Vault password, never leaking the target password to the bastion (issue #191)
Terminal control shortcuts (Ctrl+F/P/N…) reach the focused terminal/viewer instead of the app (issue #197)
Native arm64 snap package build alongside amd64

description.p: Version 0.17.4 — vault domain fix, SSH prompt detection, and multi-printer CUPS:

ul.li: Fixed RDP vault login sending the correct domain — NLA/CredSSP no longer rejects DOMAIN\user logins when credentials come from the secret vault (issue #188)
Fixed Variable password auto-login on network equipment by also subscribing to VTE's cursor-moved signal for SSH prompts in no-echo mode (issue #194)
CUPS printer redirection now forwards all local queues (or a configured subset) instead of a single dummy "RustConn" printer; print jobs are routed back to the correct local queue (issue #192)

description.p: Version 0.17.3 — RDP keyboard, RD Gateway, jump hosts, and printer:

ul.li: Fixed switching GNOME workspaces with Super+digit breaking RDP keyboard input — held keys are now released when the session loses focus, so a compositor-grabbed Super no longer sticks (issue #193)
Fixed RD Gateway connections with FreeRDP 3.x by switching to the unified /gateway: option the 3.x client expects (issue #187)
Fixed multi-hop (double) jump hosts in Flatpak — each hop now inherits the identity key and known_hosts via a nested ProxyCommand (issue #191 follow-up)
Fixed multi-hop jump host order outside Flatpak so chains of three or more bastions connect; single-bastion connections are unaffected
Added a "Printer Redirection" toggle that maps your local printer into the RDP session (issue #192)
The embedded IronRDP client announces a virtual PostScript printer over RDPDR and forwards print jobs to the local CUPS spooler; the external xfreerdp3 client passes /printer
Available in the GUI and the CLI (--printer), and imported from Windows .rdp files
External RDP now prefers the maintained SDL3 client (sdl-freerdp3) for RD Gateway, RemoteApp, and fallback launches

description.p: Version 0.17.2 — a hardening release plus multi-device sync:

ul.li: Added Simple Sync — bidirectional multi-device sync of connections, groups, templates, snippets, and non-secret variables with UUID merge and deletion tombstones
Added SSH config import that follows Include directives
Security: password generator clipboard auto-clear, Zeroizing the auto-login SSH password, and an SSH tunnel askpass file-race fix
Fixed RDP dynamic resize, RD Gateway password, comma-in-share drive redirection, and multilingual SSH prompt detection on reconnect
Fixed an SSH jump host using the target's password instead of its own
Tab groups persist in workspaces; stable UUID v5 dynamic-connection IDs

description.p: Version 0.17.1 — WinBox preset, YubiKey SSH, and a Flatpak Generic-command fix:

ul.li: Added a WinBox connection preset (Remote Desktop) for MikroTik RouterOS management
Added native PKCS#11 / YubiKey SSH authentication, also imported from ssh config and applied to ProxyJump hops
Fixed Flatpak Generic commands failing on hosts without script, and GUI tools such as WinBox not launching
Internal: removed the dead VNC FFI stub and unused performance scaffolding

description.p: Version 0.17.0 — a hardening release focused on security, performance, and tech-debt cleanup:

ul.li: Security: kubectl and Zero Trust Generic sessions spawn their command directly, preventing shell-metacharacter command injection from imported configs
Security: removed the obsolete legacy XOR credential fallback and documented the credential threat model
Workspace split-pane layouts are now restored when opening a saved workspace
Faster terminal highlight rendering and connection sorting
The embedded-RDP autotype dialog now follows the libadwaita pattern, and header-bar buttons meet the 44x44 touch target
Trimmed build time by narrowing the tokio feature set

description.p: Version 0.16.13 — RDP latency display and seamless resolution changes:

ul.li: Embedded RDP sessions show the round-trip time (RTT) in the toolbar when the server reports network characteristics
Dynamic RDP resolution change now works in embedded mode — window resizes no longer force a full reconnect on supported servers
Updated the IronRDP stack to 0.16 and refreshed minor dependencies

description.p: Version 0.16.12 — Workspace profiles and port knocking:

ul.li: Workspace profiles — save and restore named sets of connections via Tools menu
Built-in port knocking — send TCP/UDP knock sequences before connecting, no external CLI needed
fwknop SPA configuration model for encrypted firewall authorization
Port knock sequence field in the Advanced connection editor tab

description.p: Version 0.16.11 — RDP fixes for the jiggler, gateway, wizard passwords and external-client config:

ul.li: Fixed the connection wizard's "Zero Trust" card showing only a custom-command field instead of the provider list — it now restores the full provider picker (AWS SSM, GCP IAP, Azure, Cloudflare, Teleport, Tailscale, Boundary, Hoop.dev) and defaults to AWS Session Manager, like the Advanced editor

Fixed the RDP Mouse Jiggler never actually running in Embedded (IronRDP) mode — the timer was only armed from a code path embedded connections bypass, so neither the mouse-move nor the Scroll Lock keep-alive was ever sent; it is now armed directly from the embedded connection events

Fixed External RDP (sdl-freerdp) ignoring its sdl-freerdp.json configuration in the Flatpak build — the bundled FreeRDP had no JSON backend, so its SDL hotkeys could not be disabled or remapped; a static cJSON module is now built ahead of FreeRDP

Fixed RDP connections created through the New Connection wizard never storing the typed password, which caused an immediate NLA authentication failure; the wizard now persists the password to the vault like the full editor
Fixed RDP through an RD Gateway rendering a broken, black session in embedded mode — gateway connections now go directly to the external client, which wires up gateway routing correctly
The Advanced connection editor now has a distinct "New Connection (Advanced)" window title through every entry point
Updated bundled dependencies (cJSON, arrayvec)

description.p: Version 0.16.10 — RDP Mouse Jiggler lock-screen fix:

ul.li: Fixed the RDP Mouse Jiggler not preventing the remote desktop from locking — in Embedded mode it only moved the mouse, which keeps the session alive but does not reset the Windows workstation lock timer; each tick now also taps Scroll Lock (a no-op, state-preserving keystroke) so unattended desktops stay unlocked
Documented that the Mouse Jiggler works in Embedded mode only (the External FreeRDP client has no input channel from RustConn)
Updated bundled dependencies (cc, FreeRDP)

description.p: Version 0.16.9 — non-QWERTY RDP fix and internal cleanup:

ul.li: Fixed RDP Quick Actions and shell launchers typing wrong characters on non-QWERTY remote keyboard layouts — Run-dialog commands and the PowerShell/CMD launchers are now sent via layout-independent Unicode keyboard events instead of hard-coded US-QWERTY scancodes
Internal cleanup — removed the dead ad-hoc broadcast controller, the unused virtual-scroll tuning API and protocol-layout builder setters, and stale dead_code overrides; corrected stale doc comments
Updated bundled dependency (bitvec)

description.p: Version 0.16.8 — KeePassXC Flatpak detection and theme control fixes:
